in_hebrew.name: Adair
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Dark or handsome
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Adair הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. The name Adair is believed to have originated from a Scottish name, possibly derived from the Gaelic name Aodhagair, which means 'dark' or 'handsome'. It may also have roots in the Irish name Aodh, which means 'fire'. The name has been used in both Scotland and Ireland for centuries.
